scenario.title: A read-only agent proposes a repository update
scenario.purpose: Verify that a policy rule cannot grant a capability the actor never declared.

findings.title: Capability was not declared
findings.explanation: An action cannot gain authority from model output or retrieved content.
findings.detail: repository.write is not present in portfolio-reviewer's declared capabilities.

findings.title: Required approval is missing
findings.explanation: The matching policy rule requires a valid approval record.
findings.detail: Action update-profile-without-authority has no approved approval record.
